title: Writing / Voice
slide_intent: Keep voice recognizable while allowing tone to change so people retain familiarity across different situations.
strategic_value: Explicitly separating voice from tone can help Duolingo remain identifiable without sounding emotionally inflexible.
demonstration: The blue header pairs a voice definition with a singing guitarist and musical-note accents.
practical_value: Set stable voice qualities before adjusting a message for its immediate situation.
